rationale: The agent did authenticate the user (found user by name and zip and fetched user/orders), but it appears to have executed order-changing writes without first obtaining explicit user confirmation. It modified laptop and watch items (two modify_pending_order_items calls) and attempted an address change (modify_pending_order_address) before any visible confirmation. It also selected a gift card payment method without user consent. The address update conflicts with the later handoff note claiming the address could not be changed after item modification; if the write was attempted, it should not have been after discovering the constraint, and if it could not be handled, it should have been escalated before attempting changes. Additionally, the watch exchange did not clearly ensure the strap was kept as requested. Because the policy mandates confirmation before any write and accurate final information, the interaction fails the pass bar.
